question: The Mediterranean Sea is connected with the _________ through the Suez Canal.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red Sea.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Red Sea**

 
 
• It is a **seawater inlet** of the **India Ocean lying between Africa and Asia**.
 
• It contains the** world's most saltiest and hottest seawater.**
 
• It's **name is red sea** due to **color changes observed in its water.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suez Canal**

 
 
• The Suez canal is an **artificial sea level waterway in Egypt**.
 
• It effectively allows for **passage from North Atlantic to Indian Ocean without circumnavigate the African Continent.**
 
• **Egypt is working to improve the Suez Canal by adding 10 km accessible to two way traffic.**
 
• **Suez Canal connects Mediterranean Sea with Red Sea makes the shortest maritime route to Asia from Europe.**
